_comment: Layout of the home theater shown on the home screen. Meters; the listener sits at x=0,z=0 facing -z (12 o'clock = the TV); the couch is centered 'couch.z' behind that. A tower goes at 'clock' + 'distance' around the listener, or at 'x' + 'z', where 'z' can be "tv" (in line with the TV stand) or "couch" (level with the couch). A subwoofer with 'corner' stands in that corner, 'gap' meters off both walls. 'facing': "forward" keeps a speaker's front parallel to the front wall, "across" parallel to its side wall; otherwise it turns towards the listener. 'fireplace' sticks out of the middle of the front wall; the TV and its stand back onto it. 'channel' is the output channel that speaker answers to. See public/js/room/layout.js.
name: The Theater
